title: Milestone Photo Retrieval Time
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=timeline:event event_type=milestone
| stats avg(retrieval_seconds) as avg_retrieval_seconds by milestone_type
| sort - avg_retrieval_seconds
description: Measures how long it takes to retrieve representative photos for major milestones such as birthdays, moves, or graduations.
value: The value of a memory system is partly retrieval speed; if milestone memories are slow to find, organization needs work.
implementation: Store measured retrieval time on milestone timeline events and average it by milestone type.
visualization: Table of milestone types with average retrieval time.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which important life events are still slow to find photos for when you want them.
